text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? That's weird. I heard a voice 
calling from over here...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Goddesses. Could it be that you three 
are...? In that case—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Please. Keep your eyes on me!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'll give it my all in the races! And I'll 
make sure to get my body in top shape, 
too!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Just kidding. As if a prayer would do 
anything...
